objects.name: Package
objects.description: A container-like object used for transport, delivery, storage, or carrying. Typically has independent packaging structure and can be moved individually.
objects.include: - cardboard box - document envelope - plastic shipping bag - delivery bag - woven sack - hand-carried parcel - shipping box - mailer bag - poly mailer - paper envelope - bubble mailer - carton - packet
objects.exclude: - backpack worn on person - fixed trash bin - furniture cabinet - building structure - loose unpackaged items - suitcase - handbag - shopping bag carried by person

attributes.name: package_form
attributes.description: regular rectangular box / flat envelope / flexible bag / irregular shape / deformable soft packaging

attributes.name: brand_logo
attributes.description: visible logistics brand logo on package surface

quality.description: Attribute the cause of model failure in detection or classification
quality.include: Why missed detection? → heavy occlusion. Why misclassified? → blur. Why low recall? → tiny object + low light. Goal: make quality failures attributable.

attributes.name: occlusion
attributes.description: none: target fully visible. partial: partially blocked but main structure still identifiable (occlusion < 50%). heavy: largely blocked, requires guesswork (occlusion > 50%, only corner visible, heavily overlapped with background).

attributes.name: blur
attributes.description: clear: sharp edges, normal recognition. slight: minor motion blur or compression blur, still easily recognizable. heavy: significantly blurred, requires guesswork (nighttime motion trails, severe defocus, video compression artifacts).

attributes.name: lighting
attributes.description: normal: clearly visible, normal exposure. dim: dark with detail loss (nighttime, shadows, dim corridors). harsh: strong light affecting recognition (overexposure, backlight, glare, direct sunlight).

negative.description: Four categories of negative samples. When any negative flag is set, do NOT annotate this detection as a positive package.
negative.include: - Pure Negative - Hard Negative (most important) - Ambiguous (blurry negative) - Open-set Negative (out-of-distribution negative)

attributes.name: Pure Negative
attributes.description: No package exists in the scene. Example: empty corridor, only people, only vehicles, furniture, garden, lawn.

attributes.name: Hard Negative
attributes.description: Visually similar to a package but actually is not. Typical examples: backpack, suitcase, storage bin, trash bag, shopping bag, laundry bag, toolbox, pet carrier, cooler box, pillow packaging, paper bag.

attributes.name: Ambiguous
attributes.description: Unclear even to humans. Example: distant blurry cardboard box, occluded plastic bag, dark object at night, half a shipping box, low-resolution target. Do not force a positive or negative label.

attributes.name: Open-set Negative
attributes.description: Completely unknown novel object. Example: oddly shaped packaging, new delivery robot container, foreign logistics bag, never-before-seen packaging form.
